output.scope_note: The paper reports the room-temperature ionic conductivity of a PVDF-HFP/Pyr13FSI/LiFSI gel polymer electrolyte for Li-ion batteries, so it is in scope.

records.material_as_written: PVDF-HFP/Pyr13FSI/LiFSI gel electrolyte (GPE) at 3:1 mass ratio of IL solution to PVDF-HFP
records.evidence_quote: high conductivity, reaching 3.3 mS/cm at the mass ratio of 3:1, as shown in Fig. 2b and Fig. S3.
records.notes: Gel electrolyte is a quasi-solid polymer electrolyte with ionic liquid plasticizer; the value is stated as room-temperature conductivity in the introduction and results. EIS measured on SS/GPE/SS cell per Electrochemical measurements section. The 3:1 ratio is the GPE composition used for the full battery. Value repeated in the introduction as '(3.3 mS/cm)' with no separate measurement.
